keyMappings:
# Unmap defaults first
unmap gs
unmap gt
unmap gT
unmap ge
unmap gE
unmap x
unmap X
unmap yt
unmap <<
unmap >>
unmap <c-e>
unmap <c-y>
unmap yf
unmap <a-f>

# Helix base + Vimium C customs
# Scrolling
map <c-u> scrollPageUp
map <c-d> scrollPageDown
map <c-f> scrollFullPageDown
map <c-b> scrollFullPageUp
map ge scrollToBottom
map zh scrollToLeft
map zl scrollToRight

# Tabs
map gh firstTab
map gl lastTab
map gn nextTab
map gp previousTab
map ga visitPreviousTab
map d removeTab
map u restoreTab
map gC duplicateTab
map gf mainFrame

# Vomnibar
map e Vomnibar.activateEditUrl
map E Vomnibar.activateEditUrlInNewTab

# Extended hint mode
map ;y LinkHints.activateModeToCopyLinkUrl
map ;r LinkHints.activateModeWithQueue

# Visual mode
map x enterVisualLineMode
map X enterVisualMode
map \ passNextKey
